cr_data.provenance:
September 29, 1953, sold by Downtown Gallery, New York (stock no. 122) to the William H. Lane Foundation, Leominster, MA [see note 1]; 1990, gift of the William H. Lane Foundation to the MFA.  (Accession Date: September 18, 1990) 
 
NOTES: 
[1] Archives of American Art, Downtown Gallery Records, Series 4, Business Records: Sales Slips (2 of 2), 1953: Reel 5627 (Box 72), Frame 628; and Purchase Slips (2 of 2), 1953: Reel 5617, Frame 660. 
(Source: MFA Boston, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "painted 1922. See gallery photograph 2–e." Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature" [note of inscription 1]. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1922. Downtown Gallery Archive dates c. 1922. Pictured in New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 13. Mentioned in 1934 New York (An American Place) exhibition review in *New York Times* (1934). See cat. nos. 381–85, 387. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Lightning at Sea

credit_line: Gift of the William H. Lane Foundation
description: In this oval-shaped composition, a red bolt of lightning emerges from a gray cloud and strikes a deep blue ocean. Two semicircular white forms obscure the bottom left and right sides of the ocean, as though the viewer is looking through parted clouds.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
